Frozen question / operational rule: Are non-evaluated underlying predictive values/information preserved? Lossless re-expression is allowed; removal/addition/replacement or information-losing transformations are No.
Are the feature set and stable feature identities preserved? Original names, fixed anonymous identifiers, or a fixed positional mapping count as stable identity.
Is input width / number of fields preserved?
Is the non-evaluated representation / template preserved? Exact token identity is not required; representation/template/encoder changes outside the tested component are not allowed.
Is the predictive model architecture / parameterization scheme preserved?
Are training, optimization, model-selection/adaptation, and inference procedures preserved? The same prespecified procedure is sufficient even if selected hyperparameter values differ.
